name: Quantum Harmonic Oscillator and Ladder Operators
methods: Express position and momentum operators in terms of ladder operators
Utilize commutation relations [a, a^dagger] = 1 to compute matrix elements
Find ground state via annihilation condition a |0> = 0
Construct higher eigenstates by applying creation operator powers
problem_types: Calculation of expectation values <x>, <x^2>, and uncertainty product Delta x Delta p
pitfalls: Forgetting the zero-point energy (1/2) hbar omega for n = 0
Mixing up the coefficient factors between creation sqrt(n+1) and annihilation sqrt(n) operators
